name: Curious
blurb: New things, tried together. Kink exploration for two curious people.

cards.text: The Try-New-Things menu: each writes three things you're curious to explore with me — one gentle, one bold, one wild card. Trade. Pick one to order this month.
cards.soften: Say one thing you're curious about, no list.

cards.text: Blindfold them (scarf, shirt, sleep mask). Five minutes of your undivided attention — you decide everything, gently.
cards.speak: Narrate what you're about to do before you do it. Always.
cards.soften: Eyes closed, one minute of touch, narrated.

cards.text: Power swap: one of you gives a single, gentle command; the other follows for three minutes. Then swap. Safe word exists and is sacred.
cards.soften: Just trade: each names one thing you'd want the other to take the lead on.

cards.text: Ice trace: run an ice cube slowly along their collarbone and neck. Your other hand is not allowed to help.
cards.soften: Feather-light fingertip trace instead of ice.

cards.text: What's a fantasy you've never said out loud? The card swears confidentiality — what happens in Ember stays in Ember.
The tease game: whoever gives in and touches the other first loses, and grants one wish tonight. No time limit — that's the point.
cards.soften: Ten seconds of almost-touching, then swap.

cards.text: Take control of their evening for the next hour: pick the next two cards, the music, and how close they sit.
cards.soften: Take control of just the next card.

cards.text: Trade answers: what does 'being wanted' feel like for you — chased, chosen, claimed, or something else entirely?
